methodology.cold: Fresh detached worktree; dependencies installed/fetched first; independent empty build outputs for typecheck, build and test. OS and download caches retained.
methodology.incremental: Immediate no-edit repeat in the same worktree, retaining that operation's outputs. tsc explicitly enables incremental metadata; Bun rebuilds/retests; Cargo reuses artifacts.
methodology.model: Two standalone process runs after test compilation; excludes Rust compilation, includes runner startup and all model assertions/mutations. Not a cold compilation measurement.
methodology.rust: Full production binary, release size/build; dev check/test; four build jobs; three test threads, one model thread; compiler wrappers and Rust flags cleared.
methodology.scope: TypeScript Ticket/Pickup/Console slice versus Rust fresh_run/pickup_run/pickup_model plus Console status/OpenAPI/Dismissal tests. Not feature-equivalent workloads; TypeScript also runs Playwright.
methodology.runtimeMemory: Linux child ru_maxrss converted from KiB to bytes for one standalone status --json invocation per executable with empty isolated HOME/XDG state. Excludes compiler and Python parent; not aggregate process-tree or steady-state Console/Harness memory. Supplemental provenance is in runtimeMemoryEvidence.
